O.outcome_detail: right IFG and right DLPFC activation during Spanish speech perception

cells.quote: A significant three-way (age × group × similarity) interaction was found in CH31 (right IFG, F(1,80) = 10.07, pFDR = 0.048, ηp2 = 0.11) and CH37 (right DLPFC, F(1,80) = 16.16, pFDR = 0.006, ηp2 = 0.17). Simple effect analysis showed that adults with RD had a greater hemodynamic response than adults without RD in perception of Spanish syllables with high similarity to Chinese (F(1,80) = 6.92,p = 0.010 for CH31, F(1,80) = 6.92, p = 0.010 for CH37), while no significant differences were found between children without RD and children with RD.
cells.note: The contrast differs by age: adults with RD showed greater activation, whereas the child-group difference was not significant.

O.outcome_detail: left MTG deactivation during Spanish versus Chinese speech production

cells.quote: Simple effect analysis indicated that individuals without RD exhibited greater deactivationfor Spanish than for Chinese (F(1,74) = 8.12, p = 0.006), whereas individuals with R D showed greater deactivation for Chinese than for Spanish (F(1,74) = 5.64, p = 0.020). The interaction could also be explained by the fact that individuals with RD had reduced deacti­vation compared to individuals without RD for Spanish production (F(1,74) = 7.10.25, p = 0.002), while no significant group difference was observed for Chinese production (F(1,74) = 0.17,p = 0.68).
cells.note: The result is a language-by-group interaction, with the group difference present for Spanish but not Chinese production.

O.outcome_detail: SVM classification accuracy for identifying RD

cells.quote: Using LOOCV, the SVM classi ﬁer yielded an accuracy ranging from 60% to 90% when classifying children, adults , or all participants across the two fNIRS tasks (Table 2).
cells.note: The study used RBF-SVM, recursive feature elimination, LOOCV, and 1000-iteration permutation testing; the classification analysis is not a randomized learning-condition comparison.

cells.note: The overall feedback-type effect size was 0.15; no pairwise effect size was reported.
